pages.title: A obra e a situação

work.title: Rebecca of Sunnybrook Farm
work.note: Rebecca of Sunnybrook Farm é um romance da americana Kate Douglas Wiggin, publicado em 1903. A obra dá contexto à missão linguística — “avaliar o nível: difficult (difícil), easy (fácil) e tricky (complicado, cheio de pegadinha)”. A referência mostra estudos difíceis e fáceis: difficult, easy, tricky.

pages.title: Reais and dollars · 1/3
paragraphs: It is ten in the morning on a busy street in New York. Luiza arrives from Brazil with a small bag. She has only reais in her wallet. She needs dollars for taxis and food. She finds a small exchange office. A man named Walt waits behind the glass.
“Good morning. How can I help you?” says Walt. “Hi. I’d like to exchange five hundred reais.” says Luiza. “Sure. Into dollars?” says Walt.

pages.title: Reais and dollars · 3/3
paragraphs: “Perfect. Could I have a receipt?” says Luiza. “Here you go. Enjoy your trip!” says Walt. Walt counts the bills twice and shows them to Luiza. She checks the numbers and nods.
